name: GraphWalks
intro: GraphWalks 是 OpenAI 发布的长上下文图推理数据集，没有配套的构建论文。模型读取哈希节点有向边表，完成精确深度 BFS 或父节点集合查询，并按官方最后一行答案格式返回节点集合。
build_method: 有向图题面与BFS/Parents标签生成；官方未公开图采样算法
task_type: 图推理, 长上下文集合预测
eval_feature: 精确深度BFS, 父节点查询, 集合F1, 最后一行答案解析
build_method_en: Directed Graph Prompt and BFS/Parents Label Generation; Graph Sampling Algorithm Not Documented
eval_feature_en: Exact-depth BFS, Parent Query, Set F1, Last-line Answer Parser
intro_en: GraphWalks is an OpenAI long-context graph-reasoning dataset without a companion construction paper. Models read a directed edge list with hashed node names, execute exact-depth BFS or parent-set queries, and return a node set in the official last-line answer format.

drawio_review_note: Verified against the official openai/graphwalks dataset card and data at revision f338bb265735a56a79f4b0f5def722c9c3268ead (README.md, schema, both Parquet files, split statistics, extraction and grading snippets). No construction paper or public graph-sampling/gold-validation code exists, so those steps are explicitly marked unavailable. The pinned schema is prompt, answer_nodes, prompt_chars, problem_type, and date_added; README prose still says answer, while actual prompts contain four worked examples rather than the prose's three-shot description. The train split has 1,150 rows: 550 BFS and 600 parents; the shorter file has 750 rows and the longer file 400. The 2026 repair changes 24 of 400 short-file parent labels and clarifies BFS wording. Models must end with Final Answer: [...]. The currently published regex then applies strip("[]") to the whole matched line before splitting, retaining the Final Answer: [ prefix for a nonempty first element and producing Final Answer: for an empty list; no corrected official parser is published. Intended grading compares node sets with precision, recall, and F1, including F1=1 for empty/empty, but executable scores inherit this parser defect.
